digest.component_or_area: configuration system and LLM duplicate detection
propositions: verify.overlap_enabled is renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to reflect what the setting produces (duplicate ticket suggestions) rather than its internal mechanism
both the TOML key and environment variable must remain permanently aliased for backward compatibility with existing project configs and deployments
the setting is currently undocumented in docs/config.md despite being an opt-in feature that incurs LLM token costs proportional to tracker size
rename implementation requires updates to the config schema coercer, deprecation registry with permanent entries, legacy env alias mappings, and all in-source readers
docs/config.md must document that the feature is advisory-only, never blocking, and that its cost scales with store size rather than ticket size
